taskContracts.objective: Define P73 auth, RBAC, and multi-user governance contracts without enabling identity mutation or runtime auth.

inputs.narrowScope: Define P73 execution contracts and governance boundary only.
safetyRules: Do not enable login, identity provider integration, user mutation, session mutation, role mutation, tenant mutation, DB writes, project mutation, provider dispatch, tool execution, worker execution, external network calls, deploy execution, release execution, export execution, package creation, or provider spend.
Auth and RBAC records must be preview-only, evidence-linked, approval-aware, cost-aware, and non-executing.

Primary UX must not expose raw JSON, raw logs, raw private project IDs, raw user IDs, raw tokens, raw policy dumps, DemoApp outside demo mode, internal phase labels outside OS Roadmap, or fake runnable auth actions.

reuseCheck.rule: Reuse shared result, report, redaction, mode guard, phase status, Command Center route, tabs, evidence, activity, and cost patterns; do not duplicate helpers.

uxUpdate.scope: No Command Center page behavior changes in P73.1.
uxUpdate.required: Future UX must show identity mode, role posture, tenant/workspace boundary, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, safety posture, and cost impact.

dataShapes: identityMode, sessionState, roleSet, permissionState, workspaceBoundary, userMutationAllowed, roleMutationAllowed, authProviderCallsAllowed, dbWritesAllowed, disabledReason, blockers, evidenceRefs, activityRefs, costImpact, ownerCapability, nextAction

inputs.commandCenterUxRequirements: Command Center UX must show identity mode, role posture, tenant/workspace boundary, next action, blockers, disabled reason, owner capability, evidence/activity location, safety posture, and cost impact without raw JSON, raw logs, raw private IDs, raw user IDs, raw tokens, raw policy dumps, DemoApp leakage, internal phase labels, or fake runnable auth actions.
playwrightTests: No new Playwright route is required for this subphase unless Command Center route behavior changes.
checkerUpdates: Add P73.1-P73.7 to OS phase status checker.
docsRoadmap: Update NEXUS platform roadmap and OS phase status.
inputs.phaseStatusUpdate: Mark P73.1 complete after validation and set nextPhase to P73.2.
finalSafetyChecks: Confirm login, identity provider integration, user/session/role/tenant mutation, DB writes, project mutation, provider/tool/worker execution, network calls, deploy/release/export execution, package creation, and provider spend were not enabled.
Confirm no projects/**, project-roadmap/**, auth/**, users/**, rbac/**, db/**, prisma/**, or migrations/** files changed.
Confirm no fake auth actions were exposed.
Confirm primary UX does not expose raw JSON, raw logs, DemoApp leakage, internal phase labels, raw tokens, raw user IDs, raw private IDs, or raw policy dumps.
gitCommands: git commit -m "docs(nexus): define p73 auth governance contract"

acceptanceCriteria: P73.1 is independently commit-ready.

No login, user/session/role/tenant mutation, DB writes, project mutation, provider/tool execution, worker execution, network call, deploy/release/export execution, package creation, or provider spend is enabled.
Validation reports pass and OS phase status is current.
